args.title: Fix parsing headers with quoted column names in CSV files
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Adjust the parsing of the header line to handle column names enclosed in double quotes. Currently, the header is split on commas directly, which does not remove double quotes around column names causing a mismatch in the number of columns expected versus found in subsequent rows. The fix is to use the existing splitFields function to properly parse the header line so that quoted column names are correctly extracted without quotes, matching the row parsing behavior and fixing the malformed row error at the first data row.
